name: Pelle
hail: If you hear this, we were here.
This is Pelle. Everyone who could still speak is speaking now, together.
We are sending everything we know, as loud as we can, while we can.
close: That is all we had time for. Goodbye.
finding: We worked this out, and it is true: {part}
{part} We were sure of it. You can be too.
Our scientists, all of them, together: {part}
{part} It took us generations. It is yours now.
Before it is too late to say it: {part}
sighting: From our sky, while we still had one: {part}
{part} We were watching. We always watched.
Our arrays saw this. They are still turning, for now. {part}
{part} Someone should know we saw it.
Recorded by people who are gone, or soon will be: {part}
archive: This is everything we knew of it. Take it. {part}
{part} It is yours now. It has to be someone's.
Our libraries, sent outward before they burn: {part}
{part} We could not keep it. You can.
Saved the only way left to us: {part}
culture: {part} We made that. We want someone to know.
We were many, and we made things. {part}
{part} It was beautiful, while it lasted.
So that we are not only a war: {part}
verdict: Our judgment, for whatever it is worth now: {part}
{part} We were wrong about so much. Not this.
We know this now, at the end: {part}
